lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx0
  profile_tactic "hu" in have hu : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := by fun_prop
  have h₀ : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne' real_inner_self_nonneg' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx0)
  profile_tactic "obtain" in obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδ⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hu.continuousAt h₀)
  exact hf
